messages:
Aisha Rahman: Spun up a first-week probe for Meridian. Goal: reduce cold starts, capture early churn signals, and hand off a 1-page ops summary to AE. Sharing quick playbook here.
Leo Martinez: Love it. Can we get the short checklist pasted?
Aisha Rahman: Sure 1) Prefill: schedule 3 runs over 48h, ~4k tokens total. 2) Cache: convo_prefix_ttl=3h (trials=30m). 3) Batch: max_batch_size=6, batch_max_tokens=100. 4) Streaming: stream=true for in-app assistant; client timeout=200ms then fall back. 5) Telemetry: emit event 'cs.probe' with fields prompt_family, tokens, fallback_variant, health_score.
Sonal Gupta: For health_score: combine usage_ratio (week/expected), pulse_satisfaction (from micro-pulse), and fallback_rate. If score < 0.6 -> auto-flag AE.
Leo Martinez: Fallback handling 1) auto-route chain: [meridian-4x, meridian-3q]. 2) If fallback_rate > 1.5% in first 72h, pause prefill and notify eng + AE.
Aisha Rahman: Add job metadata: probe:intent=onboard probe:expected_throughput=20rps so SRE knows spike is intentional.
OpsBot: JOB DONE: meridian-first-week-probe finished. Summary: 96% success, 5 slow calls (>1s), 2 fallbacks recorded.
Leo Martinez: Can someone post traces for the slow calls? Want to know if it's middleware vs model queueing.
Sonal Gupta: I'll pull traces. Quick query I'll run: `SELECT trace_id, duration_ms, stage FROM traces WHERE job='meridian-first-week-probe' AND duration_ms>1000 ORDER BY duration_ms DESC LIMIT 10;` Posting in ~15m.
Aisha Rahman: For customer handoff one-pager include: rollback (disable probe, set cache TTL=0), what to expect first 72h, AE contact template, and pulse copy. Keep it printable.
Leo Martinez: Pulse copy idea: after 2 sessions show micro-pulse: "Was this helpful? Any blockers? (2 quick taps)" Keep optional and tiny.
Sonal Gupta: Traces posted. 3 slow calls show tenant DB timeouts; 2 show model queue spikes. I'll note this in the one-pager.
Aisha Rahman: Action items: Sonal -> traces + runbook update; Leo -> AE handoff mail + one-pager; I'll coordinate follow-up meeting after artifacts posted. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: REMINDER: create ticket CS-7320 for renewal-risk monitoring if health_score < 0.6 within first 14 days.
Aisha Rahman: Thanks team. Will close once AE confirms receipt.
Leo Martinez: Draft AE email uploaded. Meeting scheduled for 10:30.
OpsBot: NOTE: this thread will archive after 7 days of inactivity.
